Axiom: The input is an `ExtractionResult` object with shape: ```json { "component": "button", "svg": "", "variants": [ /* SvgVariant[] */ ], "elements": [ "icon", "label", "counter", "indicator" ], "tokenOverrides": [ /* TokenCandidate[] where match=false */ ] } ``` Every `SvgVariant` carries: `id`, `size`, `appearance`, `mode`, `state`, and `measurements` (MeasurementSet with height, width, leftPad, rightPad, borderRadius, rectFill, elements). Every `TokenCandidate` carries: `metric`, `svgValue`, `token`, `tokenValue`, `diff`, `match`.
